postgres.notes: JSONL curation is the default. Enable only after raw PostgreSQL schemas and environment credentials are configured.

notes: Codex and agent-memory traces use dedicated ingest modules; Claude and Hermes traces use the generic 2026 trace normalizer until dedicated modules exist.
The orchestrator attempts omnicoder.data_factory.curation_layers_2026 when present and otherwise applies the built-in 2025-2026 JSONL fallback curation layer.
No ORM, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, SQLite, or backup database path is used by this profile.
